Subunit_annotation_raw: SUBUNIT: Interacts with DDX5 in an RNA-independent manner (PubMed:12595555, PubMed:19995069). Interacts with CDK9 transcription elongation complex under basal conditions. Interacts with HNRNPH1; this interaction is important for the regulation of alternative splicing on G-quadruplex structures (PubMed:24910439). In vitro, the pre-miRNA processing activity of the DDX17-containing microprocessor complex is weaker than that of the DROSHA/DGCR8 microprocessor complex devoid of DDX17 (PubMed:15531877). Interacts with UPF3B (PubMed:23788676). Interacts with NFAT5; this interaction leads to DDX17 recruitment to LNC2 and S100A4 promoters and NFAT5-mediated DDX17-enhanced transactivation (PubMed:22266867). Interacts with HDAC1, HDAC2 and HDAC3; this interaction with HDAC1 and HDAC3, but not HDAC2, depends upon DDX17 acetylation (PubMed:15298701, PubMed:20663877).
